name: Amazon Pinpoint
overview: Amazon Pinpoint historically provided customer engagement campaigns/journeys; AWS has announced end-of-support on October 30, 2026 and stopped onboarding new customers in May 2025. Verify migration plans and current support status.
examSignals: Pinpoint engagement features have a published end-of-support date; do not select for a new workload
For campaigns/journeys evaluate Amazon Connect Customer engagement capabilities; messaging channel APIs continue under AWS End User Messaging
For email delivery consider SES; analytics/event collection may use Kinesis

compareWith.diff: Pinpoint historically provided customer engagement journeys/campaigns; SNS is a pub/sub notification service and is not a direct feature-equivalent replacement.
